# system.playTone

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Play a tone.

```lua
system.playTone(frequency, duration, pause)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frequency` |  | yes | in Hz (number) |
| `duration` |  | yes | in ms (number) |
| `pause` |  | yes | in ms (number, optional) |

## Returns

Nothing.
